name: io.github.fredyee/hallucc
description: HallucC: hallucination detection & AI safety gateway — verify_text (claim-level fact check with citations), verify_agent (agent output + trajectory audit), check_cua_actions (computer-use action risk gating L0-L3), check_safety (OWASP LLM Top 10 prompt-injection / jailbreak / harmful-content screening). Bring your own HallucC API key (Authorization: Bearer); quota shared with the aihcc.cloud web dashboard.
title: HallucC — Hallucination & Safety Guardian

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <你的 HallucC API key>（在 https://aihcc.cloud 注册后于 /keys 页创建；免费套餐每日有额度）
